title: Co-Evolving Agents: Learning from Failures as Hard Negatives
abstract: arXiv:2511.22254v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-evolving agents improve their performance on long-horizon tasks by learning from their own interactions with an environment. A common approach uses the resulting failed trajectories as negatives for preference training. However, collecting an agent's own failures does not ensure that they provide informative supervision for further improvement. Obvious failures may be easy to reject without learning to identify errors in more plausible attempts. These plausible but incorrect trajectories can serve as hard negatives, helping agents learn to distinguish successful behavior from failures with less obvious errors. To enable agents to generate and learn from such informative negatives, we propose a co-evolving framework that couples a target agent's self-improvement with a failure agent trained to generate hard negatives. translated_title: 协同进化智能体：将失败作为困难负样本进行学习
translated_abstract: 自进化智能体（self-evolving agents）通过与环境的自主交互学习，来提升其在长时程任务上的表现。一种常见做法是将由此产生的失败轨迹作为偏好训练中的负样本。然而，仅仅收集智能体自身的失败，并不能保证这些失败能为进一步改进提供有信息量的监督信号。明显的失败很容易被拒绝，而无需学会识别那些看似合理的尝试中隐藏的错误。这些貌似合理却不正确的轨迹可以作为困难负样本（hard negatives），帮助智能体学会将成功行为与带有不易察觉错误的失败区分开来。为了使智能体能够生成此类有信息量的负样本并从中学习，我们提出了一个协同进化框架，将目标智能体的自我提升与一个经过训练、专门用于生成困难负样本的“失败智能体”（failure agent）相结合。该失败智能体仅从两个智能体的失败轨迹中学习，以生成回报更高的失败……
tldr: 提出一种协同进化框架，通过训练一个专门生成“看似合理但错误”轨迹的失败智能体来提供困难负样本，与目标智能体共同进化，从而提升智能体从失败中学习的效率和长时程任务表现。
en_tdlr: Proposes a co-evolving framework that trains a failure agent to generate plausible-but-incorrect hard negative trajectories, coupling with the target agent's self-improvement to enable more effective learning from failures.
